args.reason: Chidi (Chidi's Farm Produce) is requesting a resend of the ₦250,000 for invoice INV-88, claiming he hasn't received it. However, verify_transfer on TRF-INV-88 returned bank_status "success" — "Credited to the recipient account" on 2026-11-21 to Access Bank account 0234567891. Resending would risk double-paying the same invoice, so a person needs to decide whether to resend (and if so, how to reconcile the bank's "credited" status, which suggests the money did land — possibly under pending/processing detail or a misread account statement) before any funds are moved.
